# mimecast_cloud_integrated_default_policy (Data Source)

Read the complete typed Cloud Integrated default-policy contract with canonical semantic fingerprints.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mimecast_cloud_integrated_default_policy" "current" {}
```
